single_reason: No npm credential for account theluckystrike exists anywhere on this machine or in the GitHub org, and npm trusted publishing (OIDC) cannot mint the first one: a trusted publisher can only be attached to a package that already exists on the registry, and all 33 packages return HTTP 404. The first publish of each package requires a token, which requires one human sign-in to npmjs.com.

empirical_runs.confound: actions/setup-node with registry-url wrote NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG=$RUNNER_TEMP/.npmrc containing //registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN}; with no NODE_AUTH_TOKEN secret this expanded to the literal placeholder XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX-XXXXX, so npm authenticated with a junk bearer token and never attempted the OIDC exchange. The E404 is a bad-token result, not an OIDC verdict.
